name: Amharic
region: Ethiopia; the Ethiopian visitor and diaspora in Kampala
translator_note: Follows the register of Android's Amharic localisation: second-person singular imperatives on buttons and slogans (ተሳፈር, ተጋራ, ተከራይ, ላክ, ቀጥል, ዝለል) with Ethiopic punctuation (። ፣ ፤ ፦), except the welcome line, which uses the fixed polite idiom እንኳን በደህና መጡ. Brands and Ugandan words stay in Latin script with an Amharic gloss on first use (ቦዳ boda, ማታቱ matatu, ሮሌክስ rolex, ስቴጅ stage); Kampala, Jinja and Uganda are transliterated. Worth flagging: the masculine-singular address reads gendered to some readers and product feature names (Comfort Map, Pulse, Foresight, Crest, the arbitrage desk) are rendered descriptively; a native reviewer should check the long marketing paragraphs for flow.
